entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a couple of weeks ago. It's just not working out for me.
Okay, I understand. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer's email address]. And hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse purchased on [Date of purchase – 15 days prior to call date]. What seems to be the issue with it?
It's supposed to track my sleep and heart rate, but it's completely inaccurate. It's basically a fancy wristband. I want to return it.

I understand your frustration. At VeloFit, we want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. According to our return policy, you have 90 days to return an item for a full refund, no questions asked. Since you're well within that time frame...
90 days? Okay, that's good to hear. Some other company only gave me 10 days for a smart watch I bought from them. This is much better.

Yes, that's correct. So, to initiate the return for the VeloBand Pulse, I'll need to generate a return shipping label for you. Do you prefer to receive it via email or would you like me to mail it to you?
Email is fine. Just get it done.

Alright, one moment. I've just emailed you the return shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the VeloBand Pulse, we will process your refund back to your original method of payment. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for the help. You've been great.
My pleasure! At VeloFit, we strive to make every experience positive. Have a wonderful day!
